rationale: BUG-3371 closed won't-fix (Option B). Materializing node_modules in gate worktrees was already rejected in BUG-3368's decision (network-dependent, non-hermetic, zero gate-code precedent) and no concrete driver for gate-side tsc coverage emerged. tsc --noEmit remains fully exercised by the standard pytest run off the gate.
rule: Epic-worktree verify gate scope deliberately excludes JS/TS type-checking of ephemeral worktree checkouts; the LL_VERIFY_GATE=1 skipif quarantine on test_tsc_noemit_passes (opencode + omp adapters) is permanent.
alternatives_rejected: Option A: bun install in setup_worktree()/verify gate (rejected per BUG-3368 decision 7801fe5b); hermetic middle path (vendored @types/bun stub or gate-specific tsconfig) noted but not pursued absent a concrete driver.
